title: NASA mission controller Tim Taylor says astronauts see things

tellings.quote: been outed, his name is Tim Taylor, is a

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a NASA mission controller, the person on the ground who helps run space flights, named Tim Taylor has said that astronauts see things in space. Michels links the name to the book American Cosmic and says Taylor has now been named publicly. If true, it would mean astronauts have encounters that the public does not hear about.
